stable.release_notes:
PipraPay v3.0.1 Update:
• Instant Alert & Multi-Channel Notification Engine (Telegram Bot, Discord Webhook, WhatsApp API, Custom SMTP Email, and SMS Gateway).
• Granular Event Routing Matrix (Admin Payment Success/Failed Alerts, Companion Device Offline Alerts, Device Low Battery Alerts, Customer Email Receipts & SMS Confirmations).
• Realtime Live Notification Test Tool.
• Automated Installation Package with schema restoration.
• Performance optimizations and bug fixes.
